items.context: @thepowerfulHRV (23.928 seguidores), en inglés: «A return to the power law trend would put Bitcoin at $614K in five years. That's a 59% CAGR. Bitcoin is criminally underpriced.» (con gráfico). Cuenta mediana con post despegando: ~2 h, 1.928 vistas, 72 likes, 11 reposts y solo 8 respuestas. Tema power law, que se responde con el post propio sobre la curva original de Dacoinminster.
items.suggested_text:
Worth splitting that 59% in two: part is the trend itself, part is closing today's gap below it. A power law is a straight line on log-log axes, so the trend's own annual growth keeps slowing as time passes. The catch-up piece is what does the heavy lifting in a five-year window.

The history cuts both ways, too. Against Dacoinminster's original 2013 curve, the 2017 top printed at 9.4x the line and the 2018 low fell below it. https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122317683030941979

The curve has been a decent gravity line for over a decade. How long price can stay on the wrong side of it is the part the model doesn't answer.
